bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/file_coordination.rs, springboard/sdk/src/fswatch.rs, springboard/src/bare/docbroker.rs, springboard/src/bare/sys.rs, springboard/sdk/src/runtime.rs, Rust std::fs and std::os::unix (Linux layer)
summary: The System framework is a set of typed Swift wrappers over POSIX file calls (FileDescriptor, FilePath, Stat, FileMode, Errno). BifrOSt has the same POSIX operations at the Linux and Rust level, plus file grants that hand apps a descriptor, advisory directory locks and a filesystem watch, but no SDK wrapper types for any of them.

features.feature: File descriptors (open, read, write, seek, close, duplicate)
features.apple: FileDescriptor, FileDescriptor.AccessMode, OpenOptions, SeekOrigin, DuplicateOptions, PipeOptions (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/system/filedescriptor)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/file_descriptor.rs (FileDescriptor, Access, OpenFlags); springboard/sdk/src/runtime.rs:373 (takes ownership of a received descriptor as a File); springboard/proto/src/sys.rs:91 (Owned fd wrapper)
features.note: A typed FileDescriptor opens with an access mode and flags, reads and writes at the position or at an offset, seeks, duplicates and refuses I/O that its access mode forbids (headless tests in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-36.rs). The received-descriptor wrapper is built 2026-10-17: FileDescriptor::from_received takes the shell's OwnedFd with an access mode and into_owned gives it back (tests file_descriptor::tests::a_received_descriptor_keeps_the_access_it_was_given). Built 2026-10-17: FileDescriptor::from_received and into_owned wrap a descriptor the shell hands over (tests in file_descriptor::tests). Left partial: the descriptor is not verified on Midget, which needs hardware. Built 2026-10-17: FileDescriptor::pipe creates a read end and a write end (springboard/sdk/src/file_descriptor.rs); tests file_descriptor::tests and sdk tests parity_sdk-os-11.rs.

features.feature: Document grants (user-chosen file access without a path)
features.apple: FileDescriptor.open with a FilePath chosen by the user (no direct Apple System type; the sandbox counterpart is the open and save panels)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/docbroker.rs:1-20 (shell opens the file as the account, refuses symlinks and .. escapes, hands the app a descriptor, checks device and inode on reopen)
features.note: Covers the open and save path. The app never receives a path, which is a stricter model than System's FilePath. Known limit: root's supplementary groups are kept while acting as the account.

Parsing with checks, component views, push and removal, lexical normalisation and the bridge to the language path type are tested headless in tests/parity_sdk-rest-06.rs. Built 2026-10-17: Root (absolute or relative), components() as a ComponentView, and to_c_string for the NUL-terminated platform string (springboard/sdk/src/typed_path.rs; tests in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-rest-06.rs). The language path type stays the storage by design.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 5 tests. Wave 4 (w4-system, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Errors come through io::Error. No typed Errno enum in the SDK, so apps match on raw codes or ErrorKind.

features.feature: Advisory directory locks for coordinated reads and writes
features.apple: No direct System type; used with NSFileCoordinator (Foundation)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/file_coordination.rs:1-20 (flock on the parent directory, shared for reads, exclusive for writes, bounded wait) and springboard/sdk/src/file_coordination.rs:105, :112 (coordinate_reading, coordinate_writing); wired: springboard/apps/files/src/coordinate.rs (writing_in) used by springboard/apps/files/src/ops.rs (transfer_now)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 3 tests. Advisory only. A process that does not coordinate is not blocked. Presenters and relinquish negotiation are not modelled. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity. Built 2026-10-17: savePresentedItemChanges negotiation before coordinated writes (sdk file_coordination save_presented_item_changes; tests file_coordination::tests) and pump of a watch stream into presenters (file_coordination::pump). Still open: relinquish.

features.apple: No direct System type; FSEvents and file coordination presenters use it
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 11 tests. A poll-based stream. Apps must call poll themselves; there is no callback API.

features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 4 (w4-system, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No typed option sets exist for file flags or open options in the SDK.

features.feature: File ownership by user and group identity
features.apple: UserID, GroupID, DeviceID, Inode (strongly typed wrappers over uid_t, gid_t, dev_t, ino_t)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/file_identity.rs (FileIdentity::of, UserId, GroupId, DeviceId, Inode); springboard/src/bare/docbroker.rs:1-20 (fsuid and fsgid switched for the calling thread)
features.note: Apps read the owning user, group, device and inode of a file and test whether two paths name the same file; tested headless in sdk tests parity_sdk-os-08.rs. Left partial 2026-10-17: the shell's identity switch for document grants is not exposed to apps. Exposing it would hand an app the account's file identity, a privilege decision for the owner, so it is not built.

gaps: File coordination is advisory and has no relinquish or save-negotiation step (springboard/sdk/src/file_coordination.rs:1-20).

The file-change feed is polled, not pushed: the app calls the watch's deliver with the current time each tick and gets each batch through a callback (springboard/sdk/src/fswatch.rs:138); nothing wakes the app when a file changes.
